summary: Per-account dealer payment schedules (Truck=personal / Credit) end-to-end validated against the preview backend AND the Expo web preview. BACKEND (pytest, 9/9 PASS, /app/test_reports/pytest/iter6_results.xml): (1) PUT /api/dealers/{id}/accounts/personal/schedule {enabled,amount:250,biweekly,next_due=tomorrow,...} -> 200 and Dealer.personal_schedule populated with exact values. (2) GET /api/dealers/payments/upcoming?days=7 returns object {days,count,items} (NOT shadowed by /dealers/{dealer_id}); the personal item has account_label='Truck', amount=250, days_until=1, overdue=false. (3) POST /api/dealers/{id}/accounts/personal/confirm-payment -> 200; personal_balance decreased by exactly 250.00; a transaction with type='payment', note='Scheduled payment', account='personal' was appended; personal_schedule.next_due_date advanced by exactly 14 days (biweekly); last_paid_date set to today. (4) PUT a credit schedule due TODAY amount=100 monthly; upcoming includes it with account_label='Credit', days_until=0, overdue=false; POST confirm-payment on credit -> credit_balance dropped by 100, next_due_date advanced 27-31 days (monthly clamp). (5) Validation: frequency='daily' rejected with 400; account='savings' rejected with 400; confirm-payment with no enabled schedule rejected with 400. (6) DELETE /api/dealers/{id}/accounts/personal/schedule -> 200; dealer.personal_schedule becomes null; upcoming no longer lists the item. (7) /dealers/payments/upcoming route is NOT shadowed by /dealers/{dealer_id} — confirmed shape {items,count,days}. FRONTEND (Playwright, web preview): (a) Dealer detail /dealer/{id}: after expanding the ACCOUNTS row, the BalanceSection renders 'BALANCES', 'CREDIT ACCOUNT' and 'TRUCK ACCOUNT' BalanceCards exactly per spec. When no schedule, set-schedule-CREDIT-ACCOUNT button is present (set-schedule-TRUCK-ACCOUNT also present when truck schedule is absent — verified earlier in run). After a schedule exists on Truck, the strip renders 'AUTO SCHEDULE' badge, '$250.00' amount, 'Every 2 weeks' (biweekly freqLabel), due status text, and the testIDs mark-paid-TRUCK-ACCOUNT + edit-schedule-TRUCK-ACCOUNT are both present; the SET PAYMENT SCHEDULE button is gone for that account. (b) The old 'SCHEDULED PAYMENTS' header and 'ADD PAYMENT ACCOUNT' button are NOT in the DOM anywhere on the dealer screen. (c) Home: [data-testid=home-payments-banner] renders with text 'PAYMENTS DUE THIS WEEK\n1 due · $250.00 — TEST_UIDealer Truck'. The per-dealer DEALER ACCOUNTS sub-line matches the spec exactly: 'Truck • $250.00 due tomorrow' for the dealer with the upcoming schedule. (d) No red screen / no app-blocking console errors on dealer detail or Home (only expected expo-notifications warnings + a transient 401 burst during AuthContext boot, which is normal). Schedule-creation through the MODAL was not exercised end-to-end through the UI because RN-web TouchableOpacity onPress did not consistently fire from headless Playwright click on the ACCOUNTS expand row or the set-schedule button (same well-known RN-web headless quirk reported in iter4/iter5 for PillButton/ThemeAccordion). Workaround used: created the schedule via the verified PUT /accounts/personal/schedule endpoint, then verified the UI strip / Home banner / sub-line render correctly. The ScheduleModal testIDs (sched-amount, sched-freq-biweekly, sched-due-date, sched-save) are present in the source at /app/frontend/src/sections/BalanceSection.tsx lines 335/351/363/392 and the save handler calls api.setAccountSchedule which is the same PUT endpoint validated by backend tests, so the modal save path is wired correctly.

integration_issues.flow: Schedule modal open & save (web preview only)
integration_issues.issue: Headless Playwright click/mouse/pointer events on the ACCOUNTS expand row (testID=details-row-accounts) and on set-schedule-TRUCK-ACCOUNT did NOT toggle the RN TouchableOpacity onPress in headless web preview (same RN-web quirk reported in iter4/iter5 for other TouchableOpacity components). On a real device/Expo Go this path is correct: tap → setExpandedRow('accounts') renders BalanceSection → tap set-schedule → ScheduleModal opens → sched-amount / sched-freq-biweekly / sched-due-date / sched-save are present in source and wired to api.setAccountSchedule. Main agent should self-verify the modal tap-flow on a real device.

action_items: Main agent: on a real device (or via Expo Go), verify the schedule MODAL flow: tap ACCOUNTS row → tap SET PAYMENT SCHEDULE (Truck) → modal opens with sched-amount, sched-freq-biweekly, sched-due-date, sched-save; fill 250 + biweekly + tomorrow + Save; confirm the schedule strip then shows AUTO SCHEDULE, $250.00, 'Every 2 weeks', due-tomorrow text, mark-paid-TRUCK-ACCOUNT, and edit-schedule-TRUCK-ACCOUNT. The underlying PUT endpoint and the resulting render were both verified by this run.

Optional cleanup: /app/frontend/src/sections/PaymentAccountsSection.tsx and the unused upcomingPayments helper at /app/frontend/src/api.ts:721-724 are now dead code (the new model replaces the old). Backend endpoints /api/payment-accounts/* are also unused per agent note. Consider removing in a follow-up to shrink the bundle and avoid confusion.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py is 5098 lines — well over the 700-line guideline. Strongly recommend splitting into modules (dealers, schedules, tools, auth, admin, backups). Not blocking but compounding tech-debt.

Route ordering: /api/dealers/payments/upcoming (defined at server.py:1641) coexists cleanly with /api/dealers/{dealer_id} (1387) because they have different path-segment counts — confirmed not shadowed in this run, but adding any /api/dealers/{x}/{y} route in the future could collide. Consider moving payments endpoints under /api/dealer-payments/ for safety.

PaymentAccountsSection.tsx + /api/payment-accounts/* are now dead code per the new per-account model; leaving them in invites future regression bugs (someone could re-wire the old UI). Recommend removing.
/app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx is 1071 lines — also above 700-line guideline; the in-app 'was it processed?' Alert flow and the home-rows renderer would split out cleanly.
All interactive elements on the new schedule UI carry testIDs (set-schedule-*, mark-paid-*, edit-schedule-*, sched-amount/freq-*/due-date/save) — good test-id discipline.
MongoDB ObjectId is correctly stripped via {_id: 0} projection on every dealer read used by the new endpoints — no leakage in returned payloads.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% — all DOM/render assertions pass (CREDIT/TRUCK labels, AUTO SCHEDULE strip with $250.00, mark-paid and edit-schedule testIDs, home-payments-banner with correct text, dealer sub-line 'Truck • $250.00 due tomorrow', old SCHEDULED PAYMENTS/ADD PAYMENT ACCOUNT removed). Only friction: the in-modal tap-to-save flow could not be exercised end-to-end through headless Playwright due to a known RN-web TouchableOpacity onPress quirk; worked around by creating the schedule via the verified backend PUT and validating the resulting UI.

context_for_next_testing_agent: BASE = https://toolbox-vault-v3.preview.emergentagent.com. Admin: MechanicLTZ@gmail.com / Blue321!. To bypass login in Playwright on the web preview, add an init script that does localStorage.setItem('tt.auth.token', JWT) AND localStorage.setItem('tt.auth.user', JSON_OF_ME) BEFORE goto. AuthContext re-validates against /api/auth/me on boot — the very first batch of /api/* requests at page load may 401 because the in-memory token isn't loaded yet (expected, do not flag). RN-web TouchableOpacity onPress does NOT reliably fire from page.click(force=True), page.mouse.click, or dispatched PointerEvents in headless web preview — testIDs are present in DOM but the React handler doesn't run. Recommended workaround: change app state via the backend API (verified working) and verify the resulting UI render. The dealer detail screen requires expanding the ACCOUNTS row (testID=details-row-accounts) before the BalanceSection (CREDIT/TRUCK cards) is mounted. The Home screen has DEALER ACCOUNTS rows that show a sub-line under each dealer name when paymentSubByDealer[d.id] is set (see app/(tabs)/index.tsx:294-296). Backend regression suite for schedules: /app/backend/tests/test_dealer_schedules.py — 9 tests, all green.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no defects found. All spec items confirmed (backend endpoints, validation, model shape, response shape, route non-shadowing; frontend labels, testIDs, schedule strip, banner, sub-line, removal of old section). Only an environmental friction: headless RN-web onPress.
